title: AC1018 HATCH inactive-gradient stop DXF loss guard
scope: Prevent silent loss when a parsed DWG HATCH or MPOLYGON has isGradient=0 but retains gradient color stops, while preserving representable non-default inactive companion metadata when the caller explicitly resolves those unsupported stops. Both DXF writers emit a complete zero-stop gradient group set when inactive companion values are present. The guard keeps the entity available for an explicitly corrected retry.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.relevance: ODA lists the R2004+ gradient flag, companion fields, stop count and each stop's value/CMC fields in the HATCH body. No change to the DWG byte layout or parser was made.

dxfAuthority.title: Autodesk AutoCAD 2024 HATCH (DXF) reference
dxfAuthority.relevance: The reference applies the gradient groups to both HATCH and MPOLYGON; group 450 is optional, but if present it requires groups 451, 452, 453, 460, 461, 462 and 470. For solid hatches (450=0), remaining values are ignored but present, and group 453 is zero. This supports emitting non-default inactive companions as a complete zero-stop block while refusing retained stops.

physicalSource.repositoryStatus: external local sample; not added to this repository
physicalSource.localReaderResult: PASS: current libdxfrw imports HATCH 0x173 with isGradient=0, two stop values 0/1, C2 colors 0x0000FF/0xFFFFFF, inactive companions gradReserved=0, gradAngle=0, gradShift=0, singleColor=1, gradTint=1 and gradName=LINEAR, and two type-7 polyline paths with two vertices and bulge 1.0 on each vertex.
physicalSource.readDisposition: The source import reports 474 entity parse failures elsewhere in the drawing. This checks one typed record only and does not qualify whole-file output.

independentProjection.observation: The peer projection identifies HATCH handle [0,2,371], is_gradient_fill=0, two stops at 0/1 with C2 colors 0x0000FF/0xFFFFFF, and two derived closed polyline paths with two vertices, bulge 1.0 and no boundary handles. This is corroborative implementation evidence, not normative layout authority.

implementation.change: DRW_Hatch::validateDxf rejects isGradient=0 when gradColors is nonempty. Both HATCH and MPOLYGON writers now emit the complete gradient code set when the fill is active or any inactive companion is non-default, with validation of target version, safe name and finite scalar fields. DRW_MPolygon::validateDxf delegates to the HATCH validation.
implementation.behavior: Refuse the projection instead of dropping retained stop data. After a caller explicitly clears those stops, ASCII/Binary HATCH and MPOLYGON output preserves non-default inactive companion metadata on typed readback. No DWG parser, DWG writer, public API, or DRW_Interface callback changed.

coverage: Ordinary ASCII and Binary HATCH and MPOLYGON baseline output and typed readback
Nonempty stops with isGradient=0 are refused atomically for both entity kinds in both encodings, preserving existing destination bytes
After the caller clears unsupported stops, the same exporter succeeds and fresh typed readback preserves inactive companion fields for both entity kinds in both encodings

affectedCohort.asanRun: Not run; this scalar group-emission change adds no allocation, ownership, parser-bound, or lifetime behavior.

limitations: This guard does not determine whether the inactive stops have native rendering meaning; that remains independently unqualified.
The source drawing has unrelated entity parse failures and was not converted as a whole.

Selected HATCH import and generated HATCH/MPOLYGON refusal/readback controls do not qualify the inactive stops' native meaning, general HATCH/MPOLYGON geometry, annotation, physical-source writer output, or consumer support.
No external DWG/DXF fixture was added and no support claim is promoted.
